additional_jpeg_note: The separately uploaded stage_01, stage_02, stage_03, stage_25-stage_41 JPEGs visually match corresponding PDF page photos (grayscale resized correlation measured above 0.998 for tested pages); they are not counted again.
blockers: Stage 3 Growth & Development has no separately labelled photo set.
Only one source group/tray/collage exists for each currently represented stage; independent train/validation/test evaluation is not possible.
Stage 2 examples are crops and augmentations from one image and show late cotyledon/seedling appearance, not the earliest radicle-only germination phase.
Stage 1 consists of tray/soil-preparation panels from one collage; some crops are sequential steps, not independent cultivation samples.
Stage 4 consists of 40 page photos from one PDF/tray session; it shows harvest-ready-looking microgreens but not the cutting operation.
A reliable four-class classifier cannot be trained or validated from this set without severe source leakage and overfitting risk.
recommended_next_collection: Collect Stage 3 photos from at least 3 distinct trays as a technical minimum, preferably 10+ trays per stage, across dates/lighting/backgrounds. Keep every tray in only one split.
